hook.name: LaunchpadHookCore
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 launchpad hook that gates pool initialization to a factory-authorized address and enforces admitted quote currency pairing in beforeInitialize. The contract also implements afterSwap fee-taking, modular beforeSwap gate dispatch, and beforeAddLiquidity guards, but those permission bits are absent from the address bitmask and will not be invoked by the PoolManager.
